Painted faceted dark fantasy GAME SPRITE ANIMATION asset, not a poster. Generate one cohesive high-resolution 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW sheet of EXACTLY TWELVE equal cells, reading order left to right top to bottom. Entire sheet made in one pass for identity consistency. Use supplied references for costume and brushwork. Same ONE character in every cell. Locked orthographic three-quarter camera, faces SCREEN RIGHT in every frame; no camera rotation, mirroring, scene or perspective shifts. Same exact head/body proportions, helmet or hood geometry, weapon dimensions, hands, costume layers, palette, lighting, and pixel scale throughout. Shared ground line and stable scale; dynamic grounded lunges, torso bends and weight shifts are allowed and REQUIRED when present in approved pose reference. Preserve head size as body lowers, never shrink crouches. Weapons point toward screen-right targets. NEVER independently zoom a pose to fill its cell. Each full figure incl weapons, hat, halo, cloak stays comfortably inside cell with 15 percent empty margin on all sides. Genuine transparent background, no checkerboard drawing, no floor shadows, no labels, no borders, no scenery, no separate flying effects.
Cell 1 ready combat idle; cell 2 same idle with slight breathing; cell 3 defensive guard; cell 4 same guard bracing; cell 5 attack anticipation; cells 6,7,8 sequential early swing/cast, extension, contact; cell 9 follow-through; cell 10 recover toward the EXACT cell1 stance; cell11 small backwards hit flinch still facing right; cell12 regaining ready stance. Cells5-10 must depict SIX chronological stages of the SAME single coherent action, with anatomically continuous arms and believable weapon path. Retain character identity even in flinch; no jumping or spins. More angular PAINTED material facets like reference, not polygon outlines or generic 3D.
